Footer.tagline: Mérieux Diagnostic Machine — a diagnostic machine project for pharmacies, with its companion app MDIAG.

hero.title: Fast diagnostics, right at your pharmacy counter.
hero.text: MDM is a diagnostic machine designed for pharmacies. Paired with the MDIAG app, it brings analysis closer to the patient and simplifies access to results.
hero.visualAlt: Illustration of the MDM machine: a compact unit with a touchscreen and test slots on top.

problem.title: Getting a diagnosis is still too slow.
problem.text: Today, getting an analysis often means going through several steps and waiting. MDM starts from that observation.

items.title: Slow access to diagnostics
items.text: Between the prescription, the sampling and the results, the patient's journey gets longer.

items.title: Overloaded laboratories
items.text: Demand for analyses weighs on laboratories, which sometimes struggle to take in every patient.

items.title: Patients who wait
items.text: Waiting for an appointment, then waiting for a result: an uncertainty that is hard for patients to live with.

solution.title: Three steps, close to the patient.
solution.text: The pharmacy, a local healthcare place, becomes an access point to diagnostics.

steps.title: Sampling at the pharmacy
steps.text: The pharmacist takes the appropriate sample: blood, nasal or saliva sample, or a prepared solution.

steps.title: Analysis by the machine
steps.text: The sample is placed in the dedicated slot of the MDM machine, which handles the analysis.

steps.title: Results in MDIAG
steps.text: The patient finds their results in the MDIAG app, clearly and securely.

machine.title: The MDM machine
machine.text: A compact machine with a touchscreen and dedicated slots for each type of test. Explore it in 3D.

app.title: The MDIAG app
app.text: Results, health history, equipped pharmacies and prescriptions: the patient's follow-up in their pocket.

hero.title: MDM, up close.
hero.text: Rotate the machine, zoom in, and tap the glowing points to discover each area.

viewer.label: Interactive 3D view of the MDM machine
viewer.help: Drag to rotate, pinch or use the wheel to zoom. Select a point to learn more.
viewer.unsupported: The 3D view is not available on this device. See the description of each area below.
viewer.placeholder: Select an area of the machine to display its details.

screen.title: Touchscreen
screen.text: Located on top of the machine, the touchscreen is used to operate MDM: start a test, follow its progress and guide the user.

spinchip.title: SPINCHIP slot
spinchip.text: On top of the machine, this slot receives the SPINCHIP blood test for blood analyses.

swab.title: Saliva and nasal tests
swab.text: This slot receives saliva and nasal tests, intended for detecting respiratory infections.

solution.title: Prepared solutions
solution.text: This slot receives prepared solutions intended to detect a potential bacterium.

detects.title: Three families of analyses.
detects.text: Each type of test has its own slot on the machine.

items.title: Blood analyses
items.text: Blood analyses performed with the SPINCHIP test inserted on top of the machine.

items.title: Respiratory infections
items.text: Nasal or saliva samples to detect respiratory infections.

items.title: Bacterial infections
items.text: Prepared solutions intended to detect a potential bacterium.

gallery.title: 3D renders
gallery.text: Final visuals will complete this gallery.

specs.title: Dimensions
specs.note: Other characteristics will be shared as the project develops.

hero.title: Health results, made simple.
hero.text: MDIAG works with the MDM machine, but also independently: the app remains useful even outside an equipped pharmacy.

withMachine.title: With the MDM machine
withMachine.text: Results of analyses performed at the pharmacy arrive directly in the patient's app.

standalone.title: Independently
standalone.text: History, prescriptions and pharmacy search remain available without going through the machine.

items.title: View your analysis results
items.text: Results are presented in a readable way, analysis by analysis, as soon as they are available.

items.title: Health history
items.text: A record of past tests to find your results and better follow their evolution.

items.title: Find an MDM-equipped pharmacy
items.text: A map to locate nearby pharmacies equipped with the machine.

items.title: Receive and present a prescription
items.text: Receive a prescription issued by a healthcare professional and present it at the pharmacy.

items.title: Secure sign-up
items.text: Sign-up through the Carte Vitale or the digital health identity, for a service framed by health authorities.

security.title: An ambition: protecting health data.
security.text: MDIAG is designed to comply with the GDPR and health data hosting requirements. This is a design goal: no certification has been obtained at this stage.
points: Designed to comply with the GDPR
Designed to comply with health data hosting requirements
Sign-up built around the Carte Vitale and the digital health identity

hero.title: A new service for your pharmacy.
hero.text: MDM is designed to fit simply on the counter and widen the pharmacy's local healthcare offer.

items.title: A new service
items.text: Offer analyses to your patients, right at the pharmacy.

items.title: Customer loyalty
items.text: A useful, visible service that strengthens the bond with your patients.

items.title: Speed
items.text: A shorter journey for the patient, closer to home.

items.title: Small footprint
items.text: A compact machine of 100 × 60 × 40 cm, designed for the counter or the confidential area.

steps.title: Welcome the patient
steps.text: The pharmacist presents the appropriate test and collects the patient's consent.

steps.title: Take the sample
steps.text: Blood, nasal or saliva sampling, or preparation of the solution depending on the analysis.

steps.title: Insert the test in the machine
steps.text: The test is placed in its dedicated slot; the touchscreen guides the pharmacist.

steps.title: Start the analysis
steps.text: The machine handles the analysis while the pharmacist stays available for other patients.

steps.title: Send the results
steps.text: Results are made available to the patient in the MDIAG app.

cta.title: Is your pharmacy interested?
cta.text: Tell us who you are: we will get back to you to discuss the project.

hero.title: Bringing diagnostics closer to the patient.
hero.text: MDM aims to make the pharmacy a local access point to diagnostics, and the MDIAG app the patient's follow-up record.

vision.title: Diagnostics that are closer and smoother.
vision.text: Laboratories are under pressure and patients wait. Pharmacies, the first local healthcare place, offer a natural setting for fast analyses paired with a clear and secure digital follow-up.

items.title: The machine
items.text: Design and develop the MDM machine: touchscreen, SPINCHIP slot, slots for nasal and saliva tests and for prepared solutions.

items.title: The MDIAG app
items.text: Develop the MDIAG app: results, health history, equipped pharmacies, prescriptions and secure sign-up.
